blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution suffers from limited reconstruction fidelity due to information loss in VAE-based latent representations. Recently, pixel-space diffusion models offer a promising high-faithfulness alternative by avoiding latent compression, but adapting them to Real-ISR remains challenging due to inherent patch boundary artifacts and degraded generative capability. To address the issues and maximize the potential of pretrained pixel-space diffusion models, we propose HiFiPix, a pixel-space Real-ISR framework capable of ultra high-fidelity reconstruction and fine-grained visual generation effects. To suppress patch boundary artifacts, we penalize unrealistic high-frequency periodic components with a Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CWSD) for image-level supervision, and Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation (MixCSD) for intermediate representation regularization. Furthermore, we uncover a heterogeneous generation-fidelity trade-off across low-rank adapters (LoRA) and propose Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) to adaptively prune LoRA layers, enhancing generative capability with minimal deterioration of reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiFiPix consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art latent space methods in terms of both restoration accuracy and perceptual quality by a large margin. Code and models will be released.
blocks.zh: 基于扩散的现实世界图像超解因基于VAE的潜在表达方式的信息丢失而使重建忠心度有限。 最近,像素-空间传播模型通过避免潜在的压缩,提供了一个有希望的高信仰替代方案,但由于固有的补丁边界文物和退化的基因能力,使其适应Real-ISR仍然具有挑战性。 为了解决这些问题并最大限度地发挥预受训练的像素-空间传播模型的潜力,我们提出HiFiPix,一个像素-空间 Real-ISR框架,能够进行超高纯度重建并有精细的视觉生成效果. 为了压制补丁边界文物,我们惩罚不切实际的高频周期组件,其中带有跨比例的波浪分辨器(CWSD)用于图像层面的监督,而Mixup Contrastic Self-Distillation(MixCSD)用于中间代表正规化。 此外,我们发现在低等适配器(LORA)之间出现了不同世代的忠诚取舍,并提议采用选择性的LORA Pruning(LORA-SP)来适应性地放出LORA地层,增强基因能力,尽量减少重建忠心的恶化。 广泛的实验表明,HiFiPix在修复精度和感知质量方面一贯比现有最先进的潜在空间方法表现得更好。 代码和模型将发布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Real - world image super - resolution (Real-ISR) targets the recovery of low - quality (LQ) images suffering from complex unknown degradations, with the goal of reconstructing high - quality (HQ) counterparts that exhibit both high fidelity and satisfying perceptual quality. Initially, GAN - based algorithms Wang et al. (2021) ; Chen et al. (2023) employ a discriminator to match the distribution of reconstructed images with that of real - scenario images. However, lacking powerful generative priors, GAN - based models exhibit limited capability for recovering fine - grained details.
blocks.zh: Real-ISR)的目标是恢复遭受复杂不明退化的低质量(LQ)图像,目标是重建既表现出高度忠诚又能满足感官品质的高质量(HQ)对应物. 最初, GAN - 基于算法 王等 (2021); 陈等. (2023)使用歧视者来匹配重建图像的分布与真实情景图像的分布. 然而,由于缺乏强大的遗传学前科,基于GAN的模型显示恢复精细细节的能力有限。

blocks.en: Over the past few years, diffusion-based generative models Rombach et al. (2022) ; Labs (2025) have advanced Real-ISR by producing highly photo-realistic details. However, existing Real-ISR methods Dong et al. (2025) ; Fang et al. (2026) typically rely on the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) Esser et al. (2021) to compress LQ inputs into the latent space for efficient denoising. This irreversible compression discards the subtle textures from LQ inputs, often leading to structural inconsistencies, ghosting artifacts, and ultimately compromised restoration fidelity. To mitigate this issue, prior works try to improve input quality Lin et al. (2024) , reduce the VAE compression ratio Yi et al. (2025) , or inject LQ features into denoising networks Yang et al. (2024) . However, these strategies fail to fundamentally address the information loss introduced by latent space compression, yielding reduced generative capability ( e . g ., blurry leaves in the top row of Fig. 1 ) or limited fidelity gains ( e . g ., distorted characters in the bottom row of Fig. 1 ). As a result, restoring highly faithful textures while preserving excellent visual quality still remains a significant challenge in Real-ISR.
blocks.zh: 在过去几年中,基于扩散的基因模型Rombach等人(2022年);Labs(2025年)通过产生高度光现实化的细节,推进了Real-ISR. 然而,现有的Real-ISR方法 Dong等人(2025年);Fang等人(2026年)通常依靠Variational Autoencoder(VAE) Esser等人(2021年)将LQ输入压缩到潜在的空间,以高效去诺. 这种不可逆的压缩将LQ输入中微妙的纹理丢弃,往往导致结构不一致,使文物幽灵化,最终损害修复忠贞. 为了缓解这个问题,先前的作品试图提高输入质量Lin等人(2024年),降低VAE压缩比Yi等人(2025年),或者将LQ特性注入去诺化网络. 杨等 (2024). 然而,这些策略并没有从根本上解决潜在的空间压缩、产生下降的基因能力(如图1上行的叶片模糊)或有限的忠诚增益(如图1下行的扭曲字符)所带来的信息损失。 因此,在Real-ISR中,恢复高度忠实的纹理同时保持优异的视觉质量仍然是一个重大挑战。

blocks.en: More recently, pixel - level text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models Yu et al. (2026) ; Cai et al. (2026) have demonstrated effectiveness in mitigating reconstruction accuracy issues by removing the VAE component. However, roughly fine-tuning pixel-space models to Real-ISR via LoRA adapters still faces two key challenges. First, pixel-space models typically adopt patch-based tokenization, while different tokens only interact within pure MLP-based attention blocks. Unlike VAE-based ones Saharia et al. (2022) ; Esser et al. (2024) , whose convolutional decoders naturally preserve spatial continuity, pixel-space decoding does not explicitly enforce information interaction across patch boundaries. This leads to discontinuities between patches and periodic grid artifacts, particularly in texture-rich regions. As shown in Fig. 2 (a), under the same training strategy, pixel-space models suffer from more severe periodic artifacts than latent models Esser et al. (2024) ; Labs (2025) , degrading the structural consistency across neighboring patches. Second, as depicted in Fig. 2 (b), although removing the VAE eliminates latent compression, it discards the compact semantic representations, making high-level semantic modeling more challenging in pure pixel space. Therefore, this weakens the generative prior and biases models toward deterministic reconstruction rather than plausible detail synthesis. Consequently, models tend to overfit reasonable but over-smoothed structures, while losing their ability to generate missing high-frequency details, especially under severe degradations.
blocks.zh: 最近,像素 - 水平文本对映(T2I)传播模型Yu等人(2026年);Cai等人. (2026)通过去除VAE组件,在缓解重建准确性问题上表现出实效. 然而,通过LORA适配器将像素空间模型大致微调为Real-ISR仍然面临两大挑战. 首先,像素-空间模型通常采用基于补丁的符号化,而不同的符号只在纯MLP的注意块内相互作用. 与基于VAE的Saharia等人(2022年);Esser等人(2024年)不同的是,Esser等人的革命解码器自然保持空间连续性,像素-空间解码没有明确执行跨补丁边界的信息交互. 这导致补丁和定期网格文物之间的不连续性,特别是在纹理丰富的地区. 如图2(a)所示,在同一培训战略下,像素空间模型受到比潜在模型Esser等人(2024年)更为严重的周期性文物;Labs(2025年),使邻居补丁的结构一致性下降。 第二,如图2(b)所示,虽然去除VAE消除了潜在的压缩,但它丢弃了紧凑的语义表述,使得在纯像素空间中高层次的语义模型更具挑战性. 因此,这削弱了对决定性重建的先天模式和偏见,而不是可信的细节综合。 因此,模型往往过于适应合理但过于松散的结构,同时丧失产生缺失的高频细节的能力,特别是在严重退化的情况下。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Fine-tuning pixel models faces two challenges compared with latent models: (a) without VAE decoders to preserve spatial continuity, pixel-space models are prone to patch boundary artifacts; (b) training progress tends to favor high-fidelity restoration at the expense of generative capability.
blocks.zh: 图2:与潜在模型相比,微调像素模型面临两个挑战:(a)没有VAE解码器来维护空间连续性,像素空间模型容易对边界文物进行补丁;(b)培训进展往往倾向于高真性修复,牺牲基因能力.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose HiFiPix , a pixel-space framework for high-fidelity Real-ISR. We first focus on patch-boundary artifacts arising from pixel-space decoding and observe that they mainly manifest as discontinuities in high-frequency structures. This motivates us to exploit coherent high-frequency information for cross-patch continuity. Specifically, we introduce a Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CSWD) that propagates high-frequency features across scales for boundary-aware image-level supervision, and further propose a Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation (MixCSD) that leverages an HQ-mixed branch to regularize intermediate representations at feature levels. Together, they provide complementary external and internal supervision to suppress patch-boundary artifacts. Furthermore, we address degradation of generative capability during training. We observe that LoRA updates across layers are not equally necessary: some deep layers merely echo transformations already made by shallower layers, contributing to overfitting pixel-level characteristics rather than preserving high-level semantics. We thus propose Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) , which detects and prunes such redundant layers via Centered Kernel Alignment-based representational Kornblith et al. (2019) , protects fidelity-critical layers from pruning, and progressively freezes rest, thereby constraining fine-tuning capacity precisely where overfitting risks occur.
blocks.zh: 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议HiFiPix,一个像素空间框架,用于高真实度Real-ISR. 我们首先关注由像素空间解码产生的补丁边界文物,并观察到它们主要表现为高频结构中的不连续性. 这促使我们利用一致的高频信息实现跨帕特的连续性。 具体地说,我们引入了一个跨尺度的波幅差异分析器(CSWD),在跨尺度上传播高频特征,用于边界感知图像层面的监督,并进一步提出一个Mixup Contrestive Self-Districtation(MixCSD),利用总部混合分支,规范特征层面的中间代表。 它们共同提供补充性的外部和内部监督,以压制补丁的界限文物。 此外,我们在培训期间处理基因能力的退化问题。 我们观察到,跨层的LORA更新并非同等必要:一些深层只是回声较浅层已经作出的变换,有助于像素水平特性的过度适应,而不是保护高层次的语义. 因此,我们提议采用选择性LORA Pruning(LORA-SP),通过以Kernel对齐为基础的中间层代表物Kornblith等人(2019年)探测和刷新这些多余的层,保护忠贞关键层免受挤压,并逐步冻结休息,从而限制精细调整能力,而正是在出现过度调整风险的地方。

blocks.en: Furthermore, existing Real-ISR benchmarks are hindered by low-quality ground truth, suffering from missing fine textures Cai et al. (2019) ; Wei et al. (2020) or background de-focus Wu et al. (2026) . As noted in A-FINE Chen et al. (2025a) , generative restoration models may yield images visually superior to these flawed GT references, rendering nearly all reference-based fidelity metrics unreliable. To address this issue, we construct Dual-Q-Bench , an ultra-high-quality paired real-world ISR benchmark captured via screen photography, whose HQ reference images feature rich textures and minimal background de-focus. Dual-Q-Bench enables reliable evaluation of both fidelity and perceptual quality. Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 此外,由于缺少精细的纹理,低质量的地面真相阻碍了现有的Real-ISR基准 蔡等人(2019年);魏等人(2020年)或背景解焦吴等人(2026年). 正如A-FINE Chen等人(2025a)所指出的,基因还原模型可能会产生比这些有缺陷的GT参考物具有视觉上优越的图像,从而使几乎所有基于参考的忠诚度量都变得不可靠。 为了解决这一问题,我们构建了双Q-Bench,这是通过屏幕摄影捕获的超高质量的对称真实世界的ISR基准,其总部参考图像具有丰富的纹理和最低限度的背景去聚焦。 双Q-Bench能够可靠地评价忠诚度和知觉质量。 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We propose HiFiPix , a Real-ISR method built on a pretrained pixel-level model, shifting Real-ISR from latent-space to pixel-space modeling, achieving high-fidelity restoration without sacrificing generative capability or inference efficiency. • We propose CSWD that propagates high-frequency features across scales for boundary-aware image-level supervision, and MixCSD , which distills clean representations to enhance patch-level discriminability, jointly mitigating patch-boundary artifacts. • We propose LoRA-SP , which identifies functionally redundant LoRA layers via representational drift and progressively prunes them while protecting fidelity-critical layers, preserving the pretrained generative prior during supervised fine-tuning. • We introduce Dual-Q-Bench , a high-quality paired Real-ISR benchmark that addresses the low-quality GT and background de-focus in existing benchmarks, enabling more reliable evaluation of both generative capability and reconstruction fidelity.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Real-world Image Super-Resolution
blocks.zh: 2.1 真实世界图像超分辨率

blocks.en: With the advent of large-scale T2I models, diffusion-based Real-ISR methods have surpassed GAN-based approaches. Existing methods utilize LQ input to control diffusion models for faithful restoration by leveraging pluggable adapters Chen et al. (2025b) , dual-stream architectures Yang et al. (2024) , ControlNet Yu et al. (2024) , initialized restoration modules Lin et al. (2024) , semantic conditioning Wu et al. (2026) , and large-scale high-quality training datasets Yu et al. (2024) . Furthermore, to fully use input information, methods like OSEDiff Wu et al. (2024b) and TSD-SR Dong et al. (2025) replace random noise with LQ images, while S3Diff Zhang et al. (2024) and ODTSR Fang et al. (2026) incorporate GAN loss to enhance perceptual quality. TVT Yi et al. (2025) increases the VAE latent resolution to improve fidelity, whereas LucidFlux Fei et al. (2026) and StrSR Wang et al. (2026a) improve fidelity by fine-tuning FLUX Labs (2025) or Z-image Cai et al. (2025) with increased VAE channel capacity. Nevertheless, these methods still operate in latent spaces, where VAE compression inevitably limits reconstruction fidelity. In contrast, we perform Real-ISR directly in pre-trained pixel spaces Cai et al. (2026) , enabling high-fidelity and perceptually pleasing Real-ISR.

(2026), 以及大规模高质量培训数据集. 余等 (2024) (中文(简体) ). 此外,为了充分利用输入信息,诸如OSEdiff Wu等人(2024年b)和TSD-SR Dong等人等方法。 (2025年)用LQ图像取代随机噪声,而S3Diff Zhang等人(2024年)和ODTSR Fang等人(2026年)则加入了GAN损失以提高知觉质量. TVT 电视剧 Yi等人(2025年)提高了VAE潜在分辨率以提高忠诚度,而LucidFlux Fei等人(2026年)和StrSR Wang等人(2026年a年)则通过微调FLUX Labs(2025年)或Z-image Cai等人(2025年)提高忠诚度,提高了VAE的信道能力. 尽管如此,这些方法仍然在潜在的空间中运作,其中VAE压缩不可避免地限制了重建忠心. 相比之下,我们直接在预训像素空间Cai 等人(2026年)中进行Real-ISR,使得高真度和感官满足Real-ISR.

blocks.en: 2.2 Pixel-space Diffusion Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 像素空间扩散模型

blocks.en: Early pixel-space diffusion models Dhariwal and Nichol (2021) ; Saharia et al. (2022) suffered from prohibitive computational costs at high resolutions. Recent works Chen et al. (2025c) ; Wang et al. (2026b) ; Li and He (2026) ; Ma et al. (2026b) ; Lu et al. (2026b) ; Ma et al. (2026a) ; Yu et al. (2026) have revisited pixel-space diffusion by improving its training efficiency, sampling strategy, and architectural design. Among them, PixelFlow Chen et al. (2025c) enables efficient end-to-end pixel-space generation, while JiT Li and He (2026) and PixelDiT Yu et al. (2026) further improve the scalability and efficiency of pixel-space modeling. HiDream-O1-Image Cai et al. (2026) extends this paradigm to a large-scale pixel-space T2I diffusion transformer with a unified generative architecture. Inspired by these advances, we explore fine-tuning pre-trained pixel-space T2I models for Real-ISR, aiming to achieve high-fidelity restoration and visually pleasant generation without VAE compression.

(2026)进一步提高像素空间模型的可伸缩性和效率. HiDream-O1-Image Cai et al. (2026)将这一范式扩展至具有统一基因结构的大型像素-空间T2I扩散变压器. 受这些进步的启发,我们探索对Real-ISR的预训像素空间T2I模型进行微调,目的是在没有VAE压缩的情况下实现高纯度修复和视觉愉快的生成.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Empirical Observations
blocks.zh: 3.1 经验观察

blocks.en: Following classical one-step fine-tuning paradigms Yi et al. (2025) , we identify two critical insights when applying HiDream-O1-Image for Real-ISR. First , patch-boundary artifacts may not arise solely from the patch-wise architecture of pixel-space models. As shown in Fig. 3 (a), grid-like artifacts become more pronounced under severe degradation than under mild degradation, suggesting that imperfect high-frequency reconstruction is an important cause of boundary artifacts, as severe degradation makes high-frequency reconstruction more challenging. This observation motivates a low-cost and architecture-agnostic strategy to explicitly regularize high-frequency components. Specifically, we design the Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator, which penalizes spurious boundary artifacts via multi-scale information constraints. Besides, we propose Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation to ensure faithful generation of genuine high-frequency details.
blocks.zh: 遵循古典的单步微调范式 在应用HiDream-O1-Image Real-ISR时, 第一,补丁边框文物可能并非完全产生于像素空间模型的补丁式架构. 如图3(a)所示,电网类文物在严重退化时比轻度退化时更为明显,这表明不完善的高频重建是边界文物的一个重要原因,因为严重的退化使得高频重建更具挑战性. 这一观察激励了一种低成本和结构不可知的战略,明确规范高频组件。 具体地说,我们设计了跨规模的 " 浪潮歧视者 " ,它通过多种规模的信息限制来惩罚虚假的边界文物。 此外,我们提议混合反射自旋,以确保忠实生成真正的高频细节。

blocks.en: Figure 3: (a) Heavier boundary artifacts when super-resolving extremely blurry input. (b) Removal of individual LoRA layers reveals trade-offs between reconstruction and generative capabilities.

blocks.en: Second , simply applying LoRA layers yields SR outputs lacking fine-grained details, indicating that such a general strategy drastically reduces the generative capability of pixel-space models. As shown in Fig. 3 (b), we perform ablation studies to investigate individual LoRA layers, then reveals that generative capacity and fidelity are non-uniformly entangled across depth: removing certain layers boosts generative expressiveness at negligible fidelity cost, whereas removing others yields a similar generative gain but at the expense of severe fidelity degradation. This heterogeneity rules out uniform layer pruning or fine-tuning as an effective strategy; therefore, we propose Selective LoRA Pruning that identifies and removes layers that mainly reduce the generation ability.
blocks.zh: 其次,仅仅应用LORA层就会产生SR输出缺乏精细的纹理细节,表明这样的一般策略大大降低了像素空间模型的基因能力. 如图3(b)所示,我们进行衰减研究,调查单个LORA层,然后发现基因能力和忠诚是非统一缠绕在深度之间的:去除某些层会以微乎其微的忠诚代价促进基因表达,而去除其他层则产生类似的基因收益,但牺牲严重的忠诚退化。 这种异质性排除了统一层的修饰或微调作为有效策略;因此,我们提出选择性LORA修饰(Selective LoRA Pruning),以识别和去除主要降低生成能力的层.

blocks.en: Inspired by Wu et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026a) that leverage DINOv3-ConvNeXt Siméoni et al. (2025) as a discriminator to enhance the visual quality, we propose Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CSWD) to extract multi-scale features and penalize the unrealistic high-frequency periodic components from boundaries, thereby alleviating patch boundary artifacts. As shown in Fig. 4 , given the super-resolved image I SR I_{\mathrm{SR}} , the frozen DINOv3-ConvNeXt first extracts multi-level features 𝑭 1 \bm{F}_{1} ∈ \in ℝ H 4 × W 4 × C \mathbb{R}^{\frac{H}{4}\times\frac{W}{4}\times C} , 𝑭 2 \bm{F}_{2} ∈ \in ℝ H 8 × W 8 × 2 ​ C \mathbb{R}^{\frac{H}{8}\times\frac{W}{8}\times 2C} , and 𝑭 3 \bm{F}_{3} ∈ \in ℝ H 16 × W 16 × 4 ​ C \mathbb{R}^{\frac{H}{16}\times\frac{W}{16}\times 4C} . Different from Wu et al. (2025) that relies on pooling or convolution layers for multi-scale down-sampling, we employ the wavelet transform (WT) to decompose features into a low-frequency sub-band 𝑳 ​ 𝑳 \bm{LL} and three high-frequency sub-bands { 𝑳 ​ 𝑯 , 𝑯 ​ 𝑳 , 𝑯 ​ 𝑯 } \left\{\bm{LH},\bm{HL},\bm{HH}\right\} , all with half the spatial resolution of input features. We discard 𝑳 ​ 𝑳 \bm{LL} and concatenate the three high-frequency sub-bands along the channel dimension, thereby focusing the discriminator on edges, textures, and periodic artifacts. The concatenated features are then compressed by trainable convolutional layers, while cascaded WT-convolution layers progressively extract deeper high-frequency representations and produce a pixel-wise discriminative score map.

blocks.en: 3.4 Selective LoRA Pruning
blocks.zh: 3.4 选择性 LoRA 运行

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 4 , we introduce Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) , a training-time mechanism that leverages the network’s internal representations to identify and freeze functionally redundant LoRA branches, thereby improving generative capacity without sacrificing restoration fidelity.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,我们引入了Selective LoRA Pruning(LORA-SP),这是一个培训时间机制,它利用网络的内部代表来识别和冻结功能上多余的LORA分支,从而在不牺牲恢复忠诚的前提下提高基因能力。

blocks.en: At each probing step, we forward the degraded input 𝑰 L ​ Q \bm{I}_{LQ} and mixture 𝒙 m ​ i ​ x = α ​ 𝑰 G ​ T + ( 1 − α ) ​ 𝑰 L ​ Q \bm{x}_{mix}=\alpha\bm{I}_{GT}+(1-\alpha)\bm{I}_{LQ} through the network to gather per - layer hidden states h ( l ) h^{(l)} . Layer - wise similarity is quantified by linear Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) Kornblith et al. (2019) and defined as:

where 𝑯 1 \bm{H}_{1} , 𝑯 2 \bm{H}_{2} and F F denote two intermediate features and Frobenius norm, respectively. We derive two EMA - smoothed per - layer metrics: anchor similarity 𝒂 ¯ ( l ) \bar{\bm{a}}^{(l)} via CKA ⁡ ( 𝒉 l ​ q ( l ) , 𝒉 l ​ q ( r ) ) \mathrm{CKA}(\bm{h}^{(l)}_{lq},\bm{h}^{(r)}_{lq}) with shallow reference layer r r (expected to decay under generative processing), and fidelity gap 𝒈 ¯ ( l ) = 1 − CKA ⁡ ( 𝒉 l ​ q ( l ) , 𝒉 m ​ i ​ x ( l ) ) \bar{\bm{g}}^{(l)}=1-\mathrm{CKA}(\bm{h}^{(l)}_{lq},\bm{h}^{(l)}_{mix}) , measuring layer - l l ’s representation shift toward high - quality targets. A layer becomes a redundancy candidate when its anchor similarity fails to drop from the prior layer, 𝒞 = { l | 𝒂 ¯ ( l ) − 𝒂 ¯ ( l − 1 ) ≥ 0 } , \mathcal{C}=\left\{\,l\;\middle|\;\bar{\bm{a}}^{(l)}-\bar{\bm{a}}^{(l-1)}\geq 0\,\right\}, (8) where layers in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} introduce no distinct additional representation transformation. Candidates are ranked and filtered against a small protected set 𝒫 \mathcal{P} of the globally most fidelity - critical layers, which are vetoed from pruning. The surviving top - ranked candidates constitute the final pruning set, 𝒮 = { l ∈ 𝒞 ∖ 𝒫 } , | 𝒮 | ≤ K , \mathcal{S}=\left\{\,l\in\mathcal{C}\setminus\mathcal{P}\,\right\},\qquad|\mathcal{S}|\leq K, (9) bounded by a fixed pruning budget K. Selected layers are not pruned abruptly: early in training they undergo a temporary windowed freeze, later transitioning to a permanent freeze once the redundancy signal stabilizes, with a soft - decay fallback when the pruning budget is saturated. blocks.en: CSWD & MixCSD. As shown in Fig. 6 , both CSWD and MixCSD effectively suppress periodic boundary artifacts, and their combination yields the best visual results. From Tab. 3 , both terms also substantially improve reconstruction fidelity (PSNR/LPIPS), yet using either alone degrades generation quality (MUSIQ/MANIQA). In contrast, combining them achieves the best fidelity without excessive loss of generation capability. CSWD and MixCSD penalize artifacts from image and intermediate feature domains, respectively, making them complementary.

blocks.en: LoRA - SP. LoRA - SP identifies redundant LoRA layers for pruning and incorporates a fidelity - aware veto mechanism, which retains critical layers by postponing their pruning to later candidates. As shown in Tab. 7 , redundancy detection alone boosts generation quality yet causes notable fidelity drops. Equipped with the fidelity - aware veto, LoRA - SP yields an improved generation - fidelity trade - off and consistently surpasses uniform and random LoRA pruning. These results validate our design and suggest an interpretable path to enhance pixel - space model generation via selective LoRA pruning. Moreover, Tab. 7 indicates that this strategy yields marginal gains for latent - space models ( e . g ., Z-Image), probably because VAE - driven semantic compression produces little layer redundancy. Hence, LoRA - SP is tailored for boosting the generation performance of pixel - space models.

blocks.en: 4.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.4 限制

blocks.en: HiFiPix suffers from two main limitations. First, while patch - boundary artifacts are mostly mitigated, several extremely blurred inputs still contain faint residual seams within texture - rich areas. Adding a generative decoder ( e . g ., PiD Lu et al. (2026a) ) could suppress these artifacts further, yet we abandon it for the additional consumption. Second, as our pipeline does not rely on text prompts, we exclude text - conditioned metrics such as CLIPIQA. These metrics focus mainly on text - image alignment, thereby our prompt - free setting yields inherently low scores that offer limited evaluation results.
blocks.zh: HiFiPix有两大限制. 首先,虽然补丁-边界文物大多得到缓解,但若干极其模糊的输入物仍然含有微弱的纹理-富含区间剩余缝隙。 添加基因解码器(如PiD Lu等人(2026a))可以进一步抑制这些文物,然而我们却为了额外的消耗而放弃了它. 第二,由于我们的管道不依赖文本提示,我们排除了文本——有条件的衡量标准,如CLIPIQA。 这些衡量标准主要侧重于文本-图像对齐,因此我们的即时-自由设置产生固有的低评分,从而提供有限的评价结果。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present HiFiPix, a pixel - space generative framework which enables faithful restoration by removing VAE compression. To mitigate patch - boundary artifacts and generative degradation, we propose CSWD, MixCSD for enhanced high - frequency reconstruction and cross - patch consistency, and LoRA - SP to generate fine-grained details with minimal fidelity sacrifice. We further construct Dual - Q - Bench, a high - quality benchmark for reliable evaluation. Experiments show HiFiPix outperforms VAE - based methods, demonstrating the promise of pixel - space modeling for Real - ISR.
blocks.zh: 我们提出HiFiPix,一个像素-空间基因框架,它通过去除VAE压缩,使忠实的恢复成为可能. 为了减少补丁-边界文物和基因退化,我们提议由CSWD、MixCSD加强高频重建和交叉-补丁一致性,以及由LORA-SP产生精细的精细细节,同时尽量减少忠诚牺牲。 我们进一步构建了双重-Q-座椅,这是可靠评估的高质量基准。 实验显示HiFiPix超越了基于VAE的方法,展示了像素的希望 - Real - ISR的空间模型.

blocks.en: A.1 Construction of Dual-Q-Bench
blocks.zh: A.1 建造双Q-奔驰

blocks.en: Existing paired Real-ISR benchmarks often suffer from low-quality or unrealistic GT, which can compromise the reliability of fidelity and generation evaluation. As shown in Fig. 7 , existing benchmarks ( e . g ., RealSR Cai et al. (2019) and DrealSR Wei et al. (2020) ) contain GT with blur details or background de-focus. Such imperfections introduce an undesirable evaluation bias: outputs with richer and more realistic details may deviate from deficient GT and receive lower fidelity scores, while outputs that closely mimic the imperfect GT may be favored instead, finally leading to unreasonable measurements, which is also indicated in Chen et al. (2025a) . Besides, background de-focus in DIV2K Agustsson and Timofte (2017) and ScreenSR Wu et al. (2026) complicates fidelity assessment, as recovering sharp structures in the background can be incorrectly penalized as deviation from the GT. Furthermore, large-model-generated GT ( e . g ., GGT-GeneralMix Kong et al. (2026) ) do not necessarily guarantee faithful details due to potential hallucinations. To address these limitations, we construct Dual-Q-Bench , a high-quality real-world paired benchmark with realistic and sharp GT images at 1024 2 1024^{2} resolution, enabling more reliable evaluation of both fidelity and generation quality.
blocks.zh: 现有配对的Real-ISR基准常常受到质量低或不切实际的GT的影响,这可能会损害忠诚和生成评价的可靠性. 如图7所示,现有基准(例如: 真实SR Cai等人(2019年)和DrealSR Wei等人(2020年)的GT中包含模糊的细节或背景去聚焦. 这种不完善带来一种不可取的评价偏差:具有更丰富和更现实细节的产出可能偏离不足的GT,获得的忠诚度分数较低,而密切模仿不完善的GT的产出则可能被偏好,最终导致不合理的计量,陈等人(2025年a)也指出了这一点。 此外,DIV2K Agustsson和Timofte(2017年)以及ScreenSR Wu等人也都对背景进行了解重点. (2026) 忠诚度评估复杂化,因为背景中恢复的尖锐结构可能因偏离GT而受到错误的处罚. 此外,大型模型生成的GT(e.g.,GGT-GeneralMix) Kong等人(2026年)由于潜在的幻觉,不一定保证忠实的细节. 为了克服这些局限性,我们构建了双Q-Bench,一个高质量的现实世界配对基准,以1024 2 1024 \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 1024\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 1024\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 1024\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 上。

blocks.en: GT Construction: We crawl high-resolution photographs from Unsplash and filter them using a combination of NR metrics ( e . g ., MANIQA Yang et al. (2022) , MUSIQ Ke et al. (2021) , Q-Insight Li et al. (2026) ), retaining only images whose aggregated score exceeds GT images in LSDIR Li et al. (2023) by an average of 30% to ensure superior intrinsic quality. Laplacian-gradient response is then used to crop texture-rich regions, followed by manual inspection to discard images with background de-focus or painterly appearance, yielding 100 100 GT images with sharp, rich details at 1024 2 1024^{2} resolution.
blocks.zh: 一般事务人员 建筑业: 我们从Unsplash爬出高分辨率照片,并使用NR度量衡(如MANIQA Yang等人(2022年),MUSIQ Ke等人(2021年),Q-Insight Li等人(2026年))组合进行过滤,仅保留LSDIR Li等人(2023年)中总分超过GT图像的图像,平均30%以确保优越的内在质量. 然后用Laplacian-梯度反应来收割纹理丰富的区域,然后进行人工检查,丢弃具有背景脱焦或画质外观的图像,生成100幅100 GT图像,在1024 2 1024^{2}解析度上有尖锐,内容丰富的细节.

blocks.en: LQ Acquisition: We obtain real-world LQ images following the same screen photographing strategy in Wu et al. (2026) . Specifically, the original GT images are shown on an ultra-high-definition screen in the Imaging Laboratory. We implement a timed routine to capture LQ from GT images displayed on - screen by using a mobile phone for real - world degradation simulation. The specific mobile phone model used for image capture will be disclosed upon acceptance of our paper.
blocks.zh: LQ 采购: 我们通过同样的屏幕拍照策略获得真实世界的LQ图像, 具体来说,最初的GT图像显示在成像实验室的超高清晰度屏幕上. 我们执行一个定时例行程序,通过使用手机进行真实世界退化模拟,从屏幕上显示的GT图像中捕获LQ。 用于图像捕捉的特定移动电话模型将在接受我们的论文后公布。

blocks.en: GT-LQ Alignment Strategy: Each LQ is registered to its GT via SIFT keypoint matching with RANSAC homography estimation, falling back to multi-scale template matching when correspondences are insufficient, and further refined by ECC for sub-pixel accuracy. The warped LQ then undergoes locally-adaptive brightness and color correction in LAB space to compensate for capture-induced illumination shifts, after which both images are center-cropped to 1024 2 1024^{2} to form the final aligned pair. Tab. 8 shows the differences between Dual-Q-Bench and existing benchmarks.
blocks.zh: GT- LQ 对齐 策略:每个LQ通过SIFT键点与RANSAC图谱估计匹配注册到其GT,当函证不足时回落到多尺度模板匹配,再由ECC进一步细化子像素精度. 扭曲的LQ随后在LAB空间进行局部适应的亮度和色调校正,以补偿捕获引发的光线变换,之后两个图像都被中圈到1024 2 1024^{2}形成最终对齐的对称. 标签8显示双Q-奔驰与现有基准之间的差异。

blocks.en: A.3 Comparison of Model Parameters
blocks.zh: A.3 示范参数比较

blocks.en: We compare generative backbone, language model, and trainable component parameters across existing Real-ISR methods in Tab. 10 . Our generative backbone is substantially more compact than methods built on large generative architectures: ODTSR and LucidFlux use 22B Qwen and 12B FLUX-dev backbones, respectively, incurring heavy parameter overhead. Furthermore, removing the text encoder cuts our total parameters relative to SDXL-, SD3-, SD3.5-, and Z-Image-based approaches such as SUPIR, FaithDiff, DiT4SR, and StrSR. Our method requires merely 207.1M trainable parameters, surpassing all multi-step methods and delivering better parameter efficiency than single-step methods relying on large-scale generative backbones (e.g., ODTSR and StrSR). While SD2.1-based single-step methods have fewer trainable parameters, they yield poorer restoration performance. Together with our competitive restoration quality, these results verify our method’s superior efficiency in both model size and fine-tuning cost.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了Tab.10中现有Real-ISR方法的基因骨干、语言模型和可训练组件参数。 我们的基因骨干比基于大型基因结构的方法要紧得多:ODTSR和LucidFlux分别使用22B Quen和12B FLUX-dev骨干,导致参数超高。 此外,删除文本编码器会削减我们相对于SDXL-,SD3-,SD3.5-,和Z-图像基方法的总参数,如SUPIR,FaithDiff,DiT4SR,和STRSR. 我们的方法只需要207.1M可训练参数,超越所有多步骤方法,提供比依靠大型基因骨干(如ODTSR和STRSR)的单步方法更好的参数效率. 虽然基于SD2.1的单步方法的可训练参数较少,但它们的恢复性能较差。 这些结果与我们具有竞争力的修复质量一道,验证了我们方法在模型大小和微调成本方面的优越效率。

blocks.en: A.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: A.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Number of Selected Layers in LoRA-SP. With 35 35 LoRA layers total for fine-tuning, Tab. 12 examines how many layers should be pruned to boost generative capability while preserving fidelity. We find that both insufficient and excessive pruning yield suboptimal results. Specifically, pruning too few layers has only a limited effect on improving generative performance. While pruning more layers can improve generative performance, it severely compromises the model’s fidelity. Pruning 4 4 layers of all LoRA layers achieves the optimal trade-off between fidelity and generative capability.
blocks.zh: LORA-SP 中选定层的数量。 共有35个 LORA 层进行微调, Tab. 12 研究了在保持忠贞性的同时应分多少层以提高基因能力。 我们发现,不充分和过度的钻探都会产生不理想的结果。 具体地说,层层太少对提高基因性能的影响有限。 尽管翻越多层可以改善基因表现,但它严重损害了模型的忠诚。 所有LORA层的4,4层都实现了忠诚和基因能力的最佳权衡.

blocks.en: Number of Distillation Layers in MixCSD. Tab. 12 analyzes the effect of intermediate layer quantity for MixCSD-based contrastive distillation. We find that insufficient distillation layers provide limited supervision, hindering the generation of high-frequency representations and thus impeding performance improvements. Conversely, distilling excessive layers imposes redundant constraints on intermediate features and reduces generative flexibility. Accordingly, we uniformly adopt 5 5 layers (roughly 1 / 7 1/7 of total layers) for contrastive distillation in final settings.
blocks.zh: MixCSD 中的分层数 。 Tab 12 分析中间层量对 MixCSD 对比蒸馏的影响 。 我们认为,蒸馏层的不足提供了有限的监督,阻碍了高频表示的产生,从而阻碍了性能的提高。 反之,蒸馏过多的层对中间特征造成多余的限制,并降低基因的灵活性. 因此,我们统一采用5个层(大约占总层的1/7),在最后环境中进行对比性蒸馏。

blocks.en: Layer-Selective Freezing vs. Layer-Adaptive Attenuation. We initially expected that layer-adaptive attenuation of LoRA across all layers would improve generative quality, as weakening the adapters should release the generative prior of the pretrained backbone. However, no gain was observed in practice: such attenuation only rescales the magnitude of each layer’s update while preserving its direction, so the adaptation drift is weakened but never removed, and every layer is left in an intermediate state that matches neither the pretrained backbone nor the converged adapter. We therefore adopt a more decisive layer-selective freezing of LoRA instead.
blocks.zh: 图层 - 选择性冻结对图层 - 调整式处理。 我们最初预计,所有各层的LORA的分层适应性衰减将提高基因质量,因为削弱适配器应在预先训练的骨干之前释放基因。 然而,在实践中没有观察到任何好处:这种衰减只会在保持其方向的同时重新调整每层更新的幅度,因此适应漂移被削弱,但从未被移除,每层都处于一个中间状态,既不匹配预先训练的骨干,也不匹配交汇的适配器. 因此,我们采用更果断的层层选择性冻结LORA。
